content: Hisilicon ISP GDC (Geometry Distortion Correction) feature is a hardware-based image processing technology developed by Hisilicon that allows for real-time correction of distortions in images caused by wide-angle lenses or other optical aberrations. By using algorithms to correct the geometry of the image, Hisilicon ISP GDC feature helps improve the overall quality of images by reducing distortion and ensuring more accurate representation of objects in the scene. This feature is commonly used in security cameras, automotive cameras, and other imaging applications where accurate image reproduction is crucial.
